name: crashpad
description: FrostIDE overlay of vcpkg's crashpad port at baseline 9eec002 (ADR 0022): the same crashpad and mini_chromium revisions, built with the pinned clang-cl on Windows, with the copyright files of every component linked in an Apache-2.0 getopt_long in place of the public-domain getopt the handler bundles, and a handler pipe that admits only the current user and SYSTEM at medium integrity or above.
